action.command: docker exec openproject env PGPASSWORD=openproject psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U openproject -d openproject -c "\d users" 2>&1 | grep -iE 'password|force|change|must' ; echo "=== full admin row ==="; docker exec openproject env PGPASSWORD=openproject psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U openproject -d openproject -x -c "SELECT * FROM users WHERE login='admin';" 2>&1 | grep -iE 'password|force|change|must|auth|id|login|admin'
